goal: Build a fake, old-fashioned SIS (a 'fake PowerSchool') with working core-module screens whose UI matches the reference captures in the Vera SIS UI research library (https://vera-sis-ui-research.zarathustra7.chatgpt.site).

stack.value: Express + EJS (server-rendered) + PostgreSQL 16 via node-postgres (pg); schema/seed in db/*.sql, idempotent at startup
stack.connection: DATABASE_URL in .env -> postgres@localhost:5432/fake_sis on Docker appsicle-postgres-1

reference.structure: window.SIS_ASSETS=(()=>{const d={keys,tables,rows};...})() — dictionary-encoded; tables[i] is column i's value dict, rows are index arrays
